title: RBI DICGC Bank Deposit Insurance Protection Scheme
source: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) / RBI
content: Bank deposits in India are insured by the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Each depositor in an insured bank is covered up to a maximum limit of ₹5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs) for both principal and interest amount across all deposit accounts (savings, current, fixed, recurring) held in the same bank and same capacity.
